test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If A + B means that A is the brother of B, A × B means that A is the sister of B, A ÷ B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the sister of R?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

The family tree is drawn.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 +
 Brother
 
 

 ×
 Sister
 
 

 ÷ 
 Father
 
 

Let's check each option one by one and find which option shows that P is the sister of R.

**Option 1) **P + Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9124c4c88fa6211532d41f5b36a974fb133b5dc6cd5a860a3fe7113fae7de103.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R. So it is incorrect.

**Option 2) **P + Q × R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca4af71978fdb64d4b571af52a881a270176c65dea88cf9f40ffe00c7913a6ef.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R. So it is incorrect.

**Option 3) **P × Q ÷ R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22b0511fde24d128d6a0aaaecff8f77ceb6929e7d51a51d3c3c5bc7a74bbb4f4.png] 

Here, P is the aunt of R. So it is incorrect.

**Option 4) **P × Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3213752494d80f5b1cc6df823e3631c44ad1c4b61634fd01a38ac42a90669bb.png] 

Here, P is the sister of R. So it correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
